label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy Leads BMW Opener
items.text: Rory McIlroy posted a bogey-free 6-under 64 at Bellerive to share the first-round lead at the BMW Championship after improving from a recent poor finish by working closely with his team.

items.headline: Scheffler on LIV Return Penalties
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said he would welcome some LIV Golf players back to the PGA Tour if they add value, but insisted any return must include penalties to maintain fairness for existing members.
